items.reason: Removing the matching logic is safe because the Prometheus endpoint reads persisted rules through ListAlertRules (pkg/services/ngalert/api/prometheus/api_prometheus.go:487), just like Ruler (pkg/services/ngalert/api/api_ruler.go:780). Unscheduled rules receive default status rather than being omitted (pkg/services/ngalert/api/prometheus/api_prometheus.go:316-327), so the alleged propagation-dependent Creating/Deleting states do not require restoration.

At public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/GrafanaGroupLoader.tsx:68, `groups.at(0)?.rules.map(...)` is one continuous optional chain. When groups is empty, the entire chain returns undefined without calling map, so the claimed exception cannot occur.

The loader explicitly passes `showLocation={false}` at public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/GrafanaGroupLoader.tsx:76. GrafanaRuleListItem forwards that value to alerting and recording rows at public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:61 and :67, overriding the default.
